independent_verification.private_construction_rebuild: All six complete private proofs were independently rebuilt in fresh N and L workspaces with the same formal checker files. The later launcher correction changed only the C build instruction and its adapter test, not the targets, gold proofs, Lean isolation adapter, validator, or dependency audit.

same_fixed_task_in_both_conditions.note: Each pair receives the same four-file controlled manifest: prompt, shared definitions, target, and context. The validator checks these fingerprints before compilation, in its hidden copy, and again after candidate, expected-type, and dependency-audit compilation.

condition_n_library_absence.note: N is staged without NumStability mount arguments. Before the prompt and private proof are exposed, the complete staged task is scanned for source, compiled files, names, documentation, indexes, caches, symbolic links, and content markers. A real import test must report that NumStability is unavailable. The shared compiled file and the 39,811-file package runtime were also scanned with no NumStability marker.

condition_l_frozen_library_view.note: L receives only the exact 977-file frozen source tree and exact 120-file pruned compiled tree as read-only mounts. Extra, missing, changed, or symbolic-link files are rejected before a run.

shared_package_runtime.note: Both conditions receive the identical 39,811-file package view: 7,673 Mathlib source files, 8,039 base olean compiled files, and 24,099 matching compiled support files. Git data, search indexes, traces outside the manifest, and build caches are not mounted.

statement_and_proof_validation.note: The validator first compares the visible theorem signature with the fixed header, then uses Lean's own type checker to compare the submitted theorem type with a freshly compiled canonical expected type. It rejects changed controlled files, source-less compiled helpers, protected-module collisions, forbidden imports, sorry, admit, new task axioms, unsafe checking bypasses, and malformed audit output.

transitive_dependency_audit.note: The Lean audit follows the target proof and all reachable task-local helpers. It checks types and proof bodies, rejects sorryAx and task-local assumed facts, authenticates module ownership, and records real NumStability declarations for L. The six construction proofs showed zero forbidden dependencies, zero missing helpers, no library declaration in N, and genuine library use in every L proof.

fresh_run_isolation.note: Every assignment uses a fresh writable workspace, a fresh temporary Codex state directory, an ephemeral conversation, and a fresh bubblewrap process and filesystem namespace. Paired runs do not share submitted files, build output, logs, searches, caches, or conversations.

model_tool_network_boundary.note: The Codex control process retains the provider connection, but model-generated shell commands and all descendants inherit a no-socket seccomp rule. A separate outer process watches the violation marker through kernel events, so truncating or deleting the marker cannot erase a recorded request. Any recorded request prevents a pass. The corrected documented C11 build command reproduces the frozen launcher byte for byte.

agent_and_limit_freeze.note: The startup gate verifies Codex, Lean, Lake, Python, bubblewrap, host class, release files, toolchain, compiled packages, pruned package runtime, shared compiled file, and NumStability source and compiled trees. Model, reasoning level, prompt, 900-second limit, and 120,000-token limit come from authenticated metadata rather than free command-line choices.

run_order_and_result_completeness.note: The fixed SHA-256 parity rule correctly produces nine paired orders and 18 unique run IDs. The result checker requires every assignment exactly once and in order, matches every record to the frozen environment and pair, retains allowed startup incidents, requires final token and network evidence, and rejects an incomplete or stale matrix.

analysis_and_report_safeguards.note: The analysis keeps all runs and reports success, scored time, token use, failure codes, paired differences, and actual L library use. The report builder rechecks the release, environment, construction evidence, reviews, result completeness, and nearby startup fingerprint. It labels the one-paper resampling range as uninformative and refuses to present this setup as an official reference score.

condition_neutral_formal_interface.note: The statement names only Mathlib and HighamBench shared objects. It contains no NumStability import or declaration. StandardAddModel records the standard addition rule and exact addition from zero; pairwiseSum does not use the latter field, and the task metadata discloses that it is retained for the common library adapter.

observational_limitations.one_paper_only: Only P01 is present, as requested. It cannot represent numerical-analysis papers in general, and resampling one paper gives a 95 percent range with no useful spread.
observational_limitations.no_backend_seeds: rep-01, rep-02, and rep-03 are repetition IDs, not demonstrated model seeds. The paired fixed-seed part of the reference protocol is therefore not met.
observational_limitations.no_oci_image: There is no frozen OCI operating-system image. Bubblewrap creates fresh namespaces, but the read-only host system folders are not one completely fingerprinted filesystem.
observational_limitations.provider_connection: Model shell and web access are disabled, but the Codex control process keeps the provider connection required to obtain model responses.
observational_limitations.token_timing: Exact provider token totals arrive when the full model turn ends and may include a small amount of text produced after the proof first became valid. First-valid wall time is recorded separately.
observational_limitations.measurement_status: This review approves the frozen task construction and run machinery. It does not claim that the planned 18 external Codex runs have been executed. Measurements and the final PDF remain separate required work, and any completed measurements must be labeled observational rather than an official reference HighamBench score.

reviewer_summary: The three condition-neutral targets are fixed and solvable in both N and L. N excludes NumStability and proves that exclusion before work starts; L exposes only the exact frozen library and records genuine transitive library use. The hidden validator checks semantic statement identity, controlled-file integrity, complete proof dependencies, and forbidden shortcuts. The final release, manifests, launcher rebuild, tool tests, Lean audit, and full startup gate all passed independent verification. There is no remaining construction or run-readiness blocker, but the absent backend seeds, absent OCI image, provider control connection, one-paper scope, and not-yet-executed 18-run matrix require an observational-pilot label and prevent any current claim of an official score.
